notes.title: Patch Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello Beasts!

 We have just release a new patch, and it's a game-saver for players on Intel processors! The update focuses on eradicating a persistent bug that has been causing game crashes, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
 The Beast Inside has just become a whole lot smoother and more beastly than ever before!

 You can always rollback to previous version of the game simply by clicking right mouse button on the game's title, select "Properties", then select "Betas" and from  the "Beta Participation" select version 1.03

notes.title: PC crash bugfix!
notes.notes:
Hello Beasts!
We started to work on a long awaited fix for the game crashing on start, but to do this, we need to gather  as much data as possible to be able to replicate the issue. People who encountered that bug, please sent us your PC specs here in the discussion, or at support@illusionray.com.

notes.title: Special Halloween Patch
notes.notes:
Beasts,

[b]let's celebrate this Halloween with a Special Halloween Treat!
[/b]

[h1]The new update is here!
[/h1]

What's in it for you?

1. Head Bobbing is now possible to turn off/on in the game options. 
2. Fixed error of falling characters after the sequence in the shed in Chapter 2.
3. Achievement for Enigma is also granted on Medium level
4. Additional tips in the form of monologues are added to Enigma scene
5. Possibility of standing up from crouching near the anomaly.
6. Improved readability of LPM and PPM icons
7. No voice overs cut when resolving an enigma
8. Rotating the Caesar disk is not dependent on FPS.
9. Possibility of changing the FOV in the range of 75-100.
10. Fixed issue where the radio in individual chapters did not turn off properly.
11. Numerous audio bug fixes in chapter 04.
12. Fixed issue where Adam's flashlight would turn off by itself in Chapter 11.
13. Fixed issue where the miner's ghost in Chapter 08 would get stuck in individual places.
14. Fixed collision errors in swamps in chapter 10 that caused a player blockage.
15. Bug with disappearing doors in escape sequence in chapter 12 has been corrected.
16. Fixed issue where stones in the well from Chapter 09 sank to the ground.
17. Patch fixes in collisions in chapter 10

[b]Also, don't forget, all the owners of Lust for Darkness, Agony and Agony Unrated - you can buy The Beast Inside with 25% OFF![/b]

And hey, a little extra treat for you - our friends from Movie Games Lunarium has just released Lust from Beyond:Prologue, an intro to the full game - Lust from Beyond, have a go, because now it is for FREE!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170820/Lust_from_Beyond_Prologue/


All The Be(a)st,

Illusion Ray Studio & Movie Games

notes.title: #1 Update has landed!
notes.notes:
Dear Beasts,

the first update for The Beast Inside has landed! 
Let’s have a look at the list of what has been improved:

1. Improved music playback and SFX balance in Chapter 10
2. Improving music analysis in Chapter 12
3. Improved collision in Adam’s world in Chapter 05/07/09
4. The error with the incorrect opening of the cut scene in Chapter 4  has been fixed
5. Balance of revolver ammunition in Chapter 4
6. Fixed a bug with getting stuck on Boss arena in Chapter 4
7. Correction in the interpretation of blur settings
8. The projector in Chapter 07 now contains the correct image at the low setting
9. In Chapter 10  the correct brightness at low settings is now improved
10. The jump icon in the table with the PS4 gamepad settings is corrected
11. QTE mouse icons are improved
12. Minor collisions’ fixes
13. Corrections in the Russian translation 
14. Corrections in the French translation 
15. Dying after successful lockpicking no longer causes an error
16. Maria in Chapter 10 no longer kills the player during lock opening sequence
17. The pipe in Adam's house no longer blocks the passage.
18. A premature fall of the bridge in Chapter 5 is no longer possible

We are working on the next patches so stay tuned and enjoy the game!

All The Be(a)st,
Illusion Ray Studio & Movie Games

P.S.
Lust for Darkness owners, remember to grab your copy with a 25% discount available exclusively for you!
